_comment: A2 CALIBRATION tasks. These are development tasks, not held-out evidence, and they are
exposed the moment they run. They exist to choose a turn ceiling, nothing else.
Drawn strictly BEFORE A1's capture boundary (c1, ebcd548d50, 2025-11-19) so that every
commit after that boundary stays available for a future A2 capture/held-out split. A
calibration set that eats the recent history buys a ceiling and spends the experiment.
Disjoint from every A1 task: d1-d4, c1-c2, h1-h4 and the boundedness rejection 9caedb9206.
Admitted under the same bar as A1 (freeze-heldout-a1 section 1): at most 6 test functions'
outcomes and at most 7 source hunks. Chosen to SPAN that bar rather than sit at one end --
a ceiling calibrated only on easy tasks is a ceiling calibrated on nothing.
